views.front: Image 1 is a 3D render of Mateo, a fictional Brazilian jiu-jitsu black belt competitor (not a real or famous person), standing in an A-pose. Image 2 is a close-up of his face for identity only. Redraw image 1 as a photorealistic full-body studio photograph of exactly the same man: same face, same short dark brown hair and short dark beard, same proportions, with the dense, powerful build of an elite, world-champion-level grappler: broad shoulders, thick neck, strong forearms, powerful legs. Same outfit: plain bright white Brazilian jiu-jitsu gi with the jacket closed and tied, matching plain white gi pants, a black belt tied at the waist, no patches, embroidery, logos, stripes or text, barefoot. POSE IS CRITICAL, copy image 1's A-pose exactly: he stands straight facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, and BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND RAISED OUT TO THE SIDES at about 45 degrees from his body, like a 3D-scanning A-pose mannequin, so there is a wide gap of empty white background between each arm and his torso and the fists are far outside the hips at upper-thigh height. The arms must not hang down by his sides. Both bare hands are clenched about 60% into a firm, partly closed fist: fingers curled toward the palm, fingertips not yet pressed into the palm, thumb resting along the index finger. Expression: a pronounced, determined, confident smirk: the left corner of his closed mouth is clearly pulled up and the right corner stays level, a slight crease beside the raised corner, no teeth, steady intense eyes looking straight into the camera, brows slightly lowered. Natural skin texture and realistic muscle definition. No logos, text or graphics anywhere. Full body visible head to feet, centered, plain white background, even soft studio lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus.
